title: Sales Tax — Zip Code accepts letters and more than 5 characters
requirementSource: NM-4021 §6.1 — Zip Code is a text input, max 5 digits
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Tax → Sales Tax for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/taxes/sales-tax) on e2e as the automation user.
expectedBehavior: Only digits are kept, at most 5.
actualBehavior: The field holds 'ab902105' (no maxlength, no digit filter) and a search sends it as zipCode.

verificationLog.finding: Reproduced live on e2e (office 1101) during NM-4021 automation; the affected test asserts the documented behaviour under test.fail.
